title: Send loads
intro: Tell {{company}} what goods you want carried. Add as many loads as you like and send them together. No app or login needed.
endedText: Ask the transporter for a new link.
yourLoads: Loads you sent from this phone
name: Your name or company
fixErrors: Please fix the boxes marked in red
sentText: {{company}} and other transporters can now see them. Open a load to see offers, change it or take it off.

form.priceHelp: Total freight you will pay for this load

err.same: Pick-up and delivery must be different
err.size: Type a size between 5 and 1500 cm
err.name: Type your name

status.reserved: Agreed — a truck will take it

share.noOffers: No offers yet. We'll show them here.
share.acceptNote: Accepting one offer turns down the others.
share.acceptedToast: Offer accepted — the truck owner is told
share.takeOffText: Truck owners will no longer see it.

owner.linkText: Send this link to traders and shippers. Each one says once who they are and gets their own page to upload loads and see your offers — no app, no login.
owner.whatsapp: Send your goods with us — post the load here (no app needed): {{link}}
owner.newLinkHelp: A new link stops the old one from working.
owner.worthYes: Yes — this covers your cost and your minimum profit.
owner.worthNo: Not enough — you need at least {{need}}.
owner.noteHint: e.g. can pick up Friday morning

join.title: Send your loads
join.intro: {{company}} uses Spareway to find trucks for goods. Tell us who you are once — you get your own page to upload loads and see offers. No app or password.
join.traderHelp: I sell goods and send them to my buyers
join.shipperHelp: I send my own goods — factory, warehouse or shop
join.phoneHelp: Your page opens again with the same mobile

portal.notFound: This page link does not work
portal.keepLink: This is your own page. Keep the link to come back any time.

trader.empty: No loads yet. Send goods to your buyers from here.
trader.goodsHint: e.g. 50 bags of cement for a buyer in Pune

shipper.empty: No shipments yet. Book your first one from here.

list.title: Load providers
list.text: Traders and shippers who joined with your provider link. Block someone who posts fake or wrong loads — their page stops and their open loads come off the market.
list.empty: Nobody has joined yet. Share your provider link from the Loads page.
list.blocked: Provider blocked — their open loads are taken off
list.unblocked: Provider unblocked — send them the link again
